name: CellFormat
description: Represents the search criteria for the cell format.
remarks: Use the FindFormat or ReplaceFormat properties of the Application object to return a CellFormat object. Use the Borders, Font, or Interior properties of the CellFormat object to define the search criteria for the cell format.
example:
Sub ChangeCellFormat()

 ' Set the interior of cell A1 to yellow.
 Range("A1").Select
 Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 36
 MsgBox "The cell format for cell A1 is a yellow interior."

 ' Set the CellFormat object to replace yellow with green.
 With Application
 .FindFormat.Interior.ColorIndex = 36
 .ReplaceFormat.Interior.ColorIndex = 35
 End With

 ' Find and replace cell A1's yellow interior with green.
 ActiveCell.Replace What:="", Replacement:="", LookAt:=xlPart, _
 SearchOrder:=xlByRows, MatchCase:=False, SearchFormat:=True, _
 ReplaceFormat:=True
 MsgBox "The cell format for cell A1 is replaced with a green interior."

End Sub

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Borders
properties.description: Returns or sets a Borders collection that represents the search criteria based on the cell's border format.

properties.name: Font
properties.description: Returns a Font object, allowing the user to set or return the search criteria based on the cell's font format.

properties.name: Interior
properties.description: Returns an Interior object allowing the user to set or return the search criteria based on the cell's interior format.

properties.name: NumberFormat
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that represents the format code for the object.

properties.name: NumberFormatLocal
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that represents the format code for the object as a string in the language of the user.

properties.name: AddIndent
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that indicates if text is automatically indented when the text alignment in a cell is set to equal distribution (either horizontally or vertically).

properties.name: IndentLevel
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that represents the indent level for the cell or range. Can be an integer from 0 to 250.

properties.name: HorizontalAlignment
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that represents the horizontal alignment for the specified object.

properties.name: VerticalAlignment
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that represents the vertical alignment of the specified object.

properties.name: Orientation
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that represents the text orientation.

properties.name: ShrinkToFit
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that indicates if text automatically shrinks to fit in the available column width.

properties.name: WrapText
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that indicates if Microsoft Excel wraps the text in the object.

properties.name: Locked
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that indicates if the object is locked.

properties.name: FormulaHidden
properties.description: Returns or sets a Variant value that indicates if the formula will be hidden when the worksheet is protected.

properties.name: MergeCells
properties.description: True if the range or style contains merged cells. Read/write Variant.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears the criteria set in the FindFormat and ReplaceFormat properties.
